package service

import (
	"context"
)

// scenario for service_write_passthrough_without_domain_validation: Write-style service methods that mostly forward to repositories without visible domain guard checks.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.
type CommentService struct {
	repo CommentRepository
}

func NewCommentService(repo CommentRepository) *CommentService {
	return &CommentService{repo: repo}
}

func (s *CommentService) PostComment(ctx context.Context, userID, postID, body string) error {
	return s.repo.Insert(ctx, userID, postID, body)
}

func (s *CommentService) DeleteComment(ctx context.Context, commentID string) error {
	return s.repo.SoftDelete(ctx, commentID)
}

func (s *CommentService) EditComment(ctx context.Context, commentID, newBody string) error {
	return s.repo.UpdateBody(ctx, commentID, newBody)
}

type CommentRepository interface {
	Insert(ctx context.Context, userID, postID, body string) error
	SoftDelete(ctx context.Context, commentID string) error
	UpdateBody(ctx context.Context, commentID, body string) error
}
